props.name: VIPER 21 rescue dummy
props.home: Props kit (north and east props lead)
props.note: About 25 lb: a duffel or sandbags in a flight suit, helmet on. ISOPREP card in the chest pocket: VIPER 21, Capt. J. Ward. First dog: RANGER. Favorite sport: hockey. Hometown: Erie, PA. Number of the day: 7.

props.name: ROTOR 3 rescue dummy
props.home: Props kit (west and south props lead)
props.note: About 25 lb: a duffel or sandbags in a dark flight suit. ISOPREP card in the chest pocket: ROTOR 3, Sgt. Ri Myong-chol. Home village: KANGSO. Favorite food: naengmyeon. Brother’s name: Chol-su. Number of the day: 4.

propUses.label: Real IED tip: the C5 roadside wall
propUses.note: Paint can at the base of the wall with a wire into the grass. Location is provisional until the prop plan is redone.

propUses.label: Real IED tip: the E2 roadside wall
propUses.note: Paint can at the base of the wall with a wire into the grass. Location is provisional until the prop plan is redone.

propUses.label: Command wire on the radar road
propUses.note: Bag on the ground with the wire laid out into the grass. Leave before 0600.

propUses.label: Pressure plate north of the airstrip
propUses.note: Flat board half buried, wires showing. Leave before 0600.

propUses.label: Supply box off target
propUses.note: Visible from 20 m. Teams carry it to the town office; recover it there or at ENDEX.

propUses.label: VIPER 21 survivor
propUses.note: Lay him in the grass, helmet on, ISOPREP card in the chest pocket. Recover him from whichever HQ or the town office he ends up at.

propUses.label: ROTOR 3 survivor
propUses.note: Place after the B6 culvert tip closes (0637). Lay him in the grass, ISOPREP card in the chest pocket.

propUses.label: Militia weapons cache
propUses.note: Leave it until ENDEX, even after a team clears it.

propUses.label: Supply box off target
propUses.note: Visible from 20 m. Recover at ENDEX if no one delivered it.

propUses.label: Device back at the D6 footbridge
propUses.note: Under the near end of the footbridge, wire into the reeds. The footbridge tip closes at 0705, so the spot is clear.

propUses.label: Device back at the E2 footbridge
propUses.note: Under the near end of the footbridge, wire into the reeds.

propUses.label: Supply box off target
propUses.note: Hidden in the grass at the grid, visible from about 10 m. The grid is given to the forces without a map marker.
